tldr: Midday batch (Sep 6) — quiet Sunday, no new model releases. Garry Tan escalates his Aside run to 'might be the best AI agent harness', arguing a small startup outguns the frontier labs on the harness+browser layer. Hermes Agent now lets you resume Codex and Claude Code sessions inside Hermes — session-level interop that kills the context-loss tax on handoffs. Rest of World maps how China is turning AI tokens into consumer currency: Kimi credit cards (Agricultural Bank + Amex), telco plans from ¥9.9/mo, restaurants handing out compute credits. OpenAI ships a detailed GPT-6 Astra prompting guide with a slop-word blocklist; LLVM developers open a debate over AGENTS.md files for AI agents; an engineer's essay warns AI incident-handling is making engineers lose touch with their systems; and a study finds a seven-minute chatbot chat beats a fact sheet at reducing conspiracy beliefs.
